title: It is too hot in Europe – level 1
paragraphs: Europe is very hot right now. Many countries are breaking old summer records. Germany has a historic day with over 41 degrees Celsius.

This hot weather is dangerous for people. In France, officials stop big music parties on the streets because of the heat. In the Netherlands, big electric buses do not work, so people can not travel. Weather experts say that hot air from the south stays under a big dome. The hot air cannot go away, so even the nights are very warm. Now, this hot weather is moving to more countries in the east.
